title: QA-Board batch file (qa/batches.yaml)
description: Batches of tests run with `qa batch`, listed in qaboard.yaml under inputs.batches, or edited in the web app's Available Tests. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/batches-running-on-multiple-inputs. Unknown keys are allowed by `qa batch` (they become input settings, read by your iter_inputs), so validators should report them as warnings.

database.description: Default database for the batches of this file, where their inputs are.

configs.description: Default configurations for the batches of this file that don't set their own.

platform.description: Default platform for the batches of this file that don't set their own.

matrix.description: Not applied to the batches: set `matrix` in each batch.

^\\..description: Hidden: not a batch, e.g. to define YAML anchors reused by batches.

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: A batch of tests: inputs, and the configurations, platform and runner to run them with.

type.description: The type of the inputs, one of inputs.types in qaboard.yaml. Its settings (globs, database, runners...) apply to the batch. `pipeline` runs other batches as steps.

runner.description: Run this batch with this runner, unless `qa batch --runner` says otherwise.

only.description: Only run on the inputs whose metadata match, e.g. `{iso: '>=800'}`, or a glob on the path.

exclude.description: Don't run on the inputs whose metadata match.

inputs.description: The inputs, relative to the database: paths, folders or globs (`*`, `**`). Each can have its own configurations: `- [input, config...]` or `- input: {settings or configs}`.

anyOf.description: A path, folder or glob, relative to the database.
{input: extra configurations, or settings like database, type, glob...}

input_settings.description: Extra configurations for this input (a list, a config, or a mapping of parameters), or settings: type, database, platform, globs, use_parent_folder, <runner>: {...}.

configurations.description: The configurations your code runs with, merged in order: names, paths or mappings of parameters (your code decides what they mean). Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/specifying-configurations

database.description: Where the inputs are. Use a mapping when the path differs between Linux and Windows. `{project}` and `{subproject}` are replaced, and environment variables expanded.

path.description: Used on the OSes not listed.

platform.description: The platform the code runs on, or simulates (e.g. linux, a chip). Default: linux, or `qa --platform`.

globs.description: Glob patterns identifying inputs inside folders, e.g. `*.jpg`.

use_parent_folder.description: The inputs are the folders containing the files matching the globs.

metadata_filter.description: Matches input metadata: a glob on the path, a comparison like `>=800`, a mapping of metadata keys to filters, or a list of filters (any).

matrix.description: Runs the batch for each combination of values. Interpolate them with `${matrix.name}` in configs. `configs`/`configurations` and `platform` are special. A list of matrices runs each one.

additionalProperties.description: The values to run with: a list, e.g. `[1, 2]`.

aliases.description: Names for groups of batches, run with `qa batch <alias>`. Aliases can list other aliases and globs like `ci-*`.

local_runner.description: Settings of the local runner (runs on this machine, in parallel).

concurrency.description: joblib's n_jobs: -1 for all CPUs, 1 for one run at a time...

threads.description: Ignored by the LSF runner: use max_threads.

max_memory.description: Memory per job, in MB (0: LSF's default).

memory.description: Old name of max_memory, only read in qaboard.yaml.

concurrency.description: Max number of jobs of a batch running at the same time (0: unlimited).

bridge.description: Format string to send LSF commands through another host, e.g. `ssh my-host {bsub_command}`.

long_queue.description: The queue used to optimize parameters from the web app (qaboard.yaml only).

celery_runner.description: Settings of the Celery runner. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/celery-integration

dask_runner.description: Settings of the Dask runner. Docs: https://samsung.github.io/qaboard/docs/dask-integration

windows_runner.description: Settings of the runner that sends runs to Windows machines via Jenkins.
